objective_stated.evidence_quote: The objective of this study was to measure whether a large language model can replace one of two human screeners

eligibility_criteria_prespecified.evidence_quote: Eligibility criteria were fixed in advance and recorded in a protocol before any data were seen.

search_reproducible.evidence_quote: The full search string and the date of each database query are reported in Appendix A

dual_independent_screening.evidence_quote: Only a single human reviewer screened each record in the present study, so we could not measure inter-rater reliability between two humans

conflicts_of_interest_declared.evidence_quote: The authors declare no competing interests, though funding sources are not itemised in the original grant records.

study_design.evidence_quote: We conducted a retrospective evaluation study using four previously completed systematic reviews as reference standards.

sample_size.evidence_quote: four previously completed systematic reviews as reference standards

country.evidence_quote: All screening was performed at a single centre in Lithuania.

main_finding.value: The model reproduced the human inclusion decisions with 0.96 recall while halving screening time
